item.fulu.formation_codex.desc: Records the formations you have met, and how they are laid out.
item.fulu.formation_codex.howto: Right-click to open it; use it on a formation eye to read its state.
codex.fulu.title: Formation Codex
codex.fulu.hint: Formations you have seen are listed by name; click one for details
codex.fulu.click_hint: Click to open this formation's details
codex.fulu.need_player: Run this in game as a player, or pass a player name
codex.fulu.detail.name: Name: %s
codex.fulu.infighting.name: Infighting Formation
codex.fulu.infighting.range: radius 10 blocks, 10 blocks down, unlimited up
codex.fulu.infighting.effect_short: makes monsters in range attack each other
codex.fulu.infighting.effect: monsters in range attack each other, and pass their attack's negative effects to the others
codex.fulu.infighting.material: 4x formation base, 1x formation eye, 2x chaos talisman
codex.fulu.infighting.activate: right-click the formation eye with a chaos talisman
codex.fulu.infighting.deactivate: right-click the formation eye with an empty hand to take the talisman back
codex.fulu.sword.name: Flying Sword Formation
codex.fulu.sword.effect: fires a volley of ten flying swords every second, shared out over the monsters in range, 5 damage each
codex.fulu.sword.material: 4 formation base, 1 formation eye, 2 flying sword talismans
codex.fulu.sword.activate: right-click the formation eye with a flying sword talisman
codex.fulu.sword.deactivate: right-click the formation eye with an empty hand to take the talisman back
codex.fulu.antigravity.name: Anti-Gravity Formation
codex.fulu.antigravity.effect_short: turns the monsters in range upside down
codex.fulu.antigravity.effect: monsters in range are flipped upside down; they cannot walk but can still attack, for 3 seconds; flying monsters are unaffected
codex.fulu.antigravity.material: 4 formation base, 1 formation eye, 2 anti-gravity talismans
codex.fulu.antigravity.activate: right-click the formation eye with an anti-gravity talisman
codex.fulu.antigravity.deactivate: right-click the formation eye with an empty hand to take the talisman back
msg.fulu.formation_eye.talisman_on: Chaos talisman fitted to the formation eye
msg.fulu.formation_eye.talisman_off: Chaos talisman removed from the formation eye
msg.fulu.formation_eye.sword_on: Flying sword talisman fitted to the formation eye
msg.fulu.formation_eye.sword_off: Flying sword talisman removed from the formation eye
msg.fulu.formation_eye.already_has_talis: There is already a talisman in it (%s) - take that one out first
msg.fulu.formation_eye.outline_wait: The boundary was just shown - give it a moment
msg.fulu.formation_eye.state.sword: flying sword talisman fitted (no effect yet)
effect.fulu.resistance_up.description: Reduces incoming damage by level; VII and above also reflect 80% back at the attacker.
codex.fulu.stand_in.name: Stand-in Formation
codex.fulu.stand_in.effect_short: takes one lethal hit for the player
codex.fulu.stand_in.effect: on the fatal hit: full heal, custom Resistance Up VIII for 30 s, 20 hit-shield points; the shield loses 4 per hit and breaks after 5; Resistance VII+ reflects 80%; the formation shatters after one save
codex.fulu.stand_in.material: formation base x4, eye x1, stand-in talisman x2
codex.fulu.stand_in.activate: right-click the eye with the stand-in talisman
codex.fulu.stand_in.deactivate: empty hand on the eye to take it back
codex.fulu.shift_blame.name: Shift-Blame Formation
codex.fulu.shift_blame.effect_short: damage is passed to another creature inside
codex.fulu.shift_blame.effect: when a creature inside is hurt, 50% of the damage is passed to another random creature inside; applies to players and monsters alike; environmental damage (fall, lava) is not shifted; bosses are immune
codex.fulu.shift_blame.material: formation base x4, eye x1, shift-blame talisman x2
codex.fulu.shift_blame.activate: right-click the eye with the shift-blame talisman
codex.fulu.shift_blame.deactivate: empty hand on the eye to take it back
codex.fulu.summon.name: Soul-Summon Formation
codex.fulu.summon.effect_short: monsters dying inside leave a soul
codex.fulu.summon.effect: a monster dying inside leaves a soul that hunts other monsters; souls last 10-15 s and at most 5 exist; souls a soul kills also trigger it; players are unaffected
codex.fulu.summon.material: formation base x4, eye x1, soul-summon talisman x2
codex.fulu.summon.activate: right-click the eye with the soul-summon talisman
codex.fulu.summon.deactivate: empty hand on the eye to take it back
codex.fulu.slippery.name: Slippery Formation
codex.fulu.slippery.effect_short: monsters inside slide like on ice
codex.fulu.slippery.effect: friction drops to 10-20%: monsters overshoot, turn wide and are knocked further; frost trail under them; flying mobs unaffected; bosses take half effect; players unaffected
codex.fulu.slippery.material: formation base x4, eye x1, slippery talisman x2
codex.fulu.slippery.activate: right-click the eye with the slippery talisman
codex.fulu.slippery.deactivate: empty hand on the eye to take it back
codex.fulu.blind.name: Blindness Formation
codex.fulu.blind.effect_short: monsters inside go blind and hunt by sound
codex.fulu.blind.effect: sight drops to 2 blocks: aggro is lost beyond that; hearing is kept, so they follow footsteps and attacks; sneaking is silent; flying mobs and bosses only half affected; the player's own sight is unaffected
codex.fulu.blind.material: formation base x4, eye x1, blindness talisman x2
codex.fulu.blind.activate: right-click the eye with the blindness talisman
codex.fulu.blind.deactivate: empty hand on the eye to take it back
codex.fulu.loop.name: Closed-Loop Formation
codex.fulu.loop.effect_short: monsters crossing the edge are warped to the far side
codex.fulu.loop.effect: a monster leaving the 10-block edge is warped to 9 blocks on the opposite side, keeping its height and facing, so it believes it keeps walking while going in circles; players unaffected; bosses immune
codex.fulu.loop.material: formation base x4, eye x1, closed-loop talisman x2
codex.fulu.loop.activate: right-click the eye with the closed-loop talisman
codex.fulu.loop.deactivate: empty hand on the eye to take it back
msg.fulu.formation_eye.ink_on: ink talisman fitted, the barrier turns into an ink painting
msg.fulu.formation_eye.ink_off: ink talisman taken back, the ink fades away
codex.fulu.distance.name: Near-Far Formation
codex.fulu.distance.effect_short: locks the distance to its target so it never reaches you
codex.fulu.distance.effect: when a monster targets a player, the distance is frozen at its initial value; it follows you forward and backward and always looks like it is walking, but can never reach you; bosses immune; players unaffected
codex.fulu.distance.material: formation base x4, eye x1, near-far talisman x2
codex.fulu.distance.activate: right-click the eye with the near-far talisman
codex.fulu.distance.deactivate: empty hand on the eye to take it back
codex.fulu.demon.name: Formation Demon
codex.fulu.demon.range: appears when 4+ active formations are placed nearby
codex.fulu.demon.effect_short: breaks formations and absorbs their remains
codex.fulu.demon.effect: 300 HP, three phases; melee 8/12/15, rune rays 6 / triple 5 / quintuple 4, burst 10; summons servants; 50% resistance to formation effects; can shatter eyes; flees underground below 10% HP
codex.fulu.demon.material: drops Demon Core and Broken Formation Rune
msg.fulu.demon.summoning: The formations resonate... something is coming
msg.fulu.demon.invul: The Demon is invulnerable - damage has no effect
msg.fulu.demon.ultimate: The Demon has locked onto you - ULTIMATE: Ink Prison
msg.fulu.demon.revive: The Demon devoured your life - it has revived
msg.fulu.demon.ultimate_failed: The ultimate failed - the Demon crumbles
msg.fulu.demon.ult_charge: The Demon is at 1 HP - it is charging
death.attack.fulu.demon_ultimate: %1$s was consumed by the Demon's ultimate
msg.fulu.formation_eye.state.time_slow: Time Slow: mobs slowed, projectiles crawl
msg.fulu.formation_eye.state.refining: Refining: slain mobs condense into essence
tooltip.fulu.essence.duration: Put it into an Essence Box to use it (no eating)

tooltip.fulu.essence.space: Swap: press Z to swap with your crosshair target
tooltip.fulu.essence.creeper: Self-destruct: press Z, no terrain damage
tooltip.fulu.essence.enderman: Void Banish: swap; low-HP mobs are erased and heal you; leaves a decoy
tooltip.fulu.essence.blaze: Netherflame is a STATE (ignores immunity): 3% max HP/s true damage + attack recoil
codex.fulu.refining.name: Refining Formation
codex.fulu.refining.effect_short: Slain mobs drop essence; eat it for a power
codex.fulu.refining.effect: Marked mobs condense into essence; eating it grants that mob's power for 15s
codex.fulu.refining.material: Materials: base x4, eye x1, refining talisman x2
codex.fulu.refining.activate: Activate: right-click the eye with a refining talisman
codex.fulu.refining.deactivate: Deactivate: right-click the eye with an empty hand
codex.fulu.ink.name: Ink Formation
codex.fulu.ink.effect: The barrier turns into an ink landscape; combat rules unchanged
codex.fulu.ink.material: Materials: base x4, eye x1, ink talisman x2
codex.fulu.ink.activate: Activate: right-click the eye with an ink talisman
codex.fulu.ink.deactivate: Deactivate: right-click with an empty hand
codex.fulu.time_slow.name: Time-Slow Formation
codex.fulu.time_slow.effect: Mobs -50% speed (bosses -40%), slower attacks, slowed projectiles
codex.fulu.time_slow.material: Materials: base x4, eye x1, time-slow talisman x2
codex.fulu.time_slow.activate: Activate: right-click the eye with a time-slow talisman
codex.fulu.time_slow.deactivate: Deactivate: right-click with an empty hand
